about: Join Fujiko and Robin, two thieves, risking all (including their clothes) to ruin the bank of the biggest 4 casinos in Money City.
Dress up for the occasion, complete all missions, fight giant UFOs, defeat dragons, and rob a train, to get the highest score possible in this fun mix of pachinko and pinball.
PS Vita: One time license fee entitles play on up to 3 PlayStation® Vita systems activated by this account.
